SELECT a.*,v.sha256,v.media_type,v.object_key,r.project_id,n_delivery.naming_integrity_kind AS naming_integrity_kind,n_delivery.naming_created_at AS naming_created_at,n_delivery.naming_input_revision AS naming_input_revision,n_delivery.naming_manifest AS naming_manifest,n_delivery.naming_review_version AS naming_review_version,n_delivery.naming_review_kind AS naming_review_kind,n_delivery.naming_m4_kind AS naming_m4_kind,n_delivery.naming_m4_revision AS naming_m4_revision,n_delivery.naming_m4_type AS naming_m4_type,n_delivery.naming_m4_manifest AS naming_m4_manifest,n_delivery.naming_pair AS naming_pair FROM bb_m4_artifact_execution_versions a
      JOIN bb_delivered_artifact_versions v ON v.id=a.artifact_id AND v.version=a.artifact_version AND v.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id
      JOIN bb_runs r ON r.id=a.run_id AND r.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id JOIN bb_projects p ON p.id=r.project_id AND p.owner_user_id=r.owner_user_id  LEFT JOIN bb_run_execution_delivery_artifact_details n_delivery ON n_delivery.owner_u
ROLLBACK
